From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Spike in 5xx/429s for /v1/generate - causing timeouts

Fyi — quick postmortem notes so far.
- Root cause: a memory-pressure event on a subset of GPU hosts caused increased inference latency; coupled with client SDKs' aggressive retry backoff (linear short backoffs), we observed a retry amplification loop.
- Impact: elevated 5xx across hosted model pool (primarily g4dn-family nodes in us-west-2), 429s where request queues exceeded per-node ingress limits.
- Mitigation in flight: evict non-critical batch jobs, spin up warm standby capacity, enable aggressive client-side retry throttling at the ingress gateway (drop/429 for high-volume API keys), and temporarily widen routing to fallback quantized variants (lower latency, slightly higher error tolerance).
- ETA: initial mitigation showing lower error rates in ~25–40 minutes; full normalization in 2–3 hours depending on customer retry behavior.

I've attached the mitigation playbook and a first pass of latency charts. Marcus — requesting approval for accelerated capacity (reserve additional nodes in us-west-2) and exec notification.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
